title: Convergence Playbook for Roadmap Cutovers: Swimlanes, Signoffs, and Escalation Signals
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: build an operational playbook and lightweight signalboard that lets PMs, Eng, Design, Security and Infra converge on roadmap cutovers with clear swimlanes, automated readiness signals, and defined escalation SLOs.

Scope: this ticket covers the first-phase deliverables: swimlane matrix + owner roster, readiness score definition, lightweight Linear + Console signalboard prototype, and a cutover checklist with rollback criteria and security signoff gates. This excludes full tooling integration with Dedicated autoscaler and on-prem upgrade automation (to be tracked separately).

Background: repeated late-stage cutover friction across product launches (notably: console release windows and dedicated capacity rollouts) has led to schedule slip and uncoordinated security signoffs. We need a reproducible, low-friction way to assert cross-team readiness and trigger escalation earlier in the cycle.
acceptance_criteria: Swimlane matrix published covering Eng/Design/Security/Infra with a named owner for each dependency type
Readiness score algorithm documented with thresholds mapped to green/amber/red and actionable remediation steps
Signalboard prototype in Console that surfaces Linear ticket readiness and fires escalation Slack notifications when thresholds cross amber -> red
Cutover playbook includes security signoff checklist, required artifacts (PRs, canaries, perf dashboard), and rollback criteria
Two dry-run validations completed in 2025-W09 cycle with annotated retrospectives
cross_team_checklist: Design: deliver final visual spec for signalboard widgets and readiness badges
Eng: expose readiness webhook and readiness_state field on Linear ticket metadata (ENG ownership)
Security: publish minimal signoff matrix and required artifacts checklist
Infra: provide expected autoscaler and capacity gating signals for Dedicated cutovers
PM: maintain owner roster and runbook, schedule two dry-run walkthroughs
risk_matrix: Risk: late security signoff -> Mitigation: pre-weekly security sync + required artifacts enforced in signalboard
Risk: signalboard spam/false positives -> Mitigation: conservative thresholds initially + 24h cooldown for alerts
Risk: unclear ownership for transitive dependencies -> Mitigation: mandatory owner field in swimlane matrix and automated escalation to team lead after two missed updates
Risk: tooling integration delays -> Mitigation: start with manual authoring and CSV ingest to bootstrap signals
telemetry_signals: Ticket readiness_state (green/amber/red) emitted to Console via webhook
Time-in-state metrics for readiness badges (how long a dependency stays amber)
Number of open blockers tagged 'cutover-critical' per release window
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (manual): publish swimlane template in Confluence and collect owner roster (2 weeks)
Phase 1 (signalboard prototype): wire Linear exports into a Console dashboard and enable Slack alerts (3 weeks)
Phase 2 (automation): add readiness_state webhook and automated badge updates; integrate with canary gating (4 weeks)
Phase 3 (scale): expand to Dedicated and Private release lanes and bake into release gating policy
